scope: Sum of independently replayed World boundaries, excluding environmental I/O; each boundary retains its own paired ratios and confirmation result. Not end-to-end application latency.
transport: Native replay stdin is the actual input file descriptor; file loading is before its timing clock. The interrupted pipe-stdin attempt is not included.
protocol: Three warmups and nine measured samples per independently launched boundary replay; three alternating control/candidate windows, plus two confirmation windows for suspected >5% phase ratios. Every canonical outcome is checked.
clockScope: Native execution excludes outcome encoding; WASM public drive includes ABI outcome encoding/copy. Each engine is compared only to its matching control. Checkpoint encoding is separately timed.
disposition: Requires correction or explicit user acceptance under specification section 9.5; no inference from prior admission-cost acceptance.
